headline: GTA 6 launches worldwide after 13 years, players explore Vice City
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI launched worldwide. The game, in development for 13 years, is expected to be one of the most popular entertainment releases ever. Coverage included a live blog tracking reactions as players began exploring the game, and reports from Australia describing players renovating houses, fixing cars, lifting weights and following the story in the Miami-inspired Vice City, with some feeling like Christmas had come early.
